_note: Everything past the basics is opened through adventures. Each unlock has 'earn': every condition must be met ('find': a special item a pet brought home from a trip, see 'finds' and the events that give them; 'first': the first of something, e.g. 'part'; 'packs_opened': packs you opened yourself). 'show' is how it looks until then: 'locked' (a tab with a padlock and the 'hint') or 'hidden' (not there at all; automation is always hidden). 'opens' is what it turns on: 'tab:<name>', 'feature:<id>' (errands, packs = your pet opening your pile of boxes, shopping = it buys more when the pile runs out, parties) or 'page:<id>' (a map page). 'announce' is what your active pet says when it opens. 'popup' is the card that pops up then: its 'title', a line of 'text' on what it does, and 'go', the tab its show me button opens (none: just lovely).

unlocks.hint: pets bring things home from their adventures

popup.title: new: the bag!
popup.text: parts your pets bring home from adventures go in the bag. try them on your pets and sew them on there!

unlocks.announce: a pet brought something home! it's in your inventory now!

popup.title: new: errands!
popup.text: with the little basket, spare pets run errands while you're busy: coins, parts and sometimes a box. they never get lost on errands.

unlocks.announce: a little basket! now i can send friends to fetch things while you're busy!

popup.title: new: bigger adventures!
popup.text: the little cart fits more friends: send small parties on adventures. and there's a gate in the fence: a whole new page on the map!

unlocks.announce: a cart! more friends can go on adventures together now! and look, there's a gate in the fence!!

popup.title: new: your pet opens boxes!
popup.text: on its comfy cushion, your pet opens the boxes on your pile while you're busy. pick which ones it may open in the boxes tab.

unlocks.announce: a comfy cushion! i can sit here and open packs for you!

popup.title: new: your pet buys boxes!
popup.text: with the piggy bank, your pet buys more boxes when the pile runs out. it always keeps the coins you set aside.

unlocks.announce: a piggy bank! now i can buy boxes when the pile runs out! i'll always keep some coins for you ♪
